claims.citation: New York Herald, 5 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Brig Emma Ives (of Sydney), Sorway, Malaga, 43 days, with
fruit, to C C Duncan. May 27, lat 34 54, lon 65 05, had heavy
weather; sprung main boom and rudder head, lost and split
sails. May 25, lat 33 59, lon 63 16, exchanged signals with
bark August (Prus), from Tarragona for New York, 87 days
out.
